results.title: Daily Insight for CEOs: The CEO’s Role in Driving Year-End Performance
results.content: November marks a critical stage in the organisation’s performance journey. With only two months remaining in 2026, CEOs must intensify their focus on delivering strategic commitments, closing performance gaps, and ensuring that resources are directed towards the results that matter most. Year-end performance does not improve through pressure alone. It requires clear priorities, timely decisions, executive ownership, and consistent monitoring of progress.

results.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
results.content: At least 26 people were killed after Russian bombs hit an aid distribution centre, in an attack that Ukraine's leader has called "utterly horrific".

results.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
results.content: A 20-year-old copilot was among nine people killed when a small jet crashed and exploded in Florida on Sunday, according to US media.

results.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
results.content: A court in South Africa has found a man guilty of stealing more than $500,000 (£372,822) in cash from a farm owned by South African president Cyril Ramaphosa, in a case that mired the head of state in an impeachment saga.

results.title: No new Ghana Cards required under biometric verification law – NIA
results.content: The National Identification Authority (NIA) has assured Ghanaians that implementing the National Identity Register Amendment Regulation, 2026 (L.I. 2523), does not require new Ghana Cards or fresh biometric registration.

results.title: Sheffield researcher helps shape global policy on school meals and child health
results.content: Dr Robert Akparibo, Senior Lecturer in Global Health and Nutrition at the University of Sheffield, is working with international organisations and researchers to ensure these issues receive the attention they deserve in global policy.

results.title: ECG awards 10 Ashanti West region customers for prompt bill payment, patronage
results.content: The Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) has awarded 10 Special Load Tariff (SLT) customers in the Ashanti West Region as part of activities marking its 2026 Customer Service Week.

results.title: Five arrested after South African farmer shot and tortured
results.content: South African police have arrested five people in connection with a brutal attack on a cattle farmer, who was assaulted and tortured in what has been described as a "senseless and barbaric" act.

results.title: We don’t need media recognition to be happy; it’s about results – NACOC on Ghana-Lebanon cocaine bust collaboration
results.content: The Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC) has defended its claim of collaborating with Lebanese authorities in a recent cocaine seizure at Beirut International Airport, despite the Lebanese agency making no mention of Ghana’s involvement in its public statement.

results.title: Two arrested over murder of female tricycle rider
results.content: Police have arrested two men over the alleged murder of a female tricycle rider and theft of her vehicle at Afrancho, near Konkoli, in the Trede District.

results.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
results.content: US President Donald Trump has notified Congress of his intention to remove South Africa and Rwanda from a preferential trade programme, from 1 January 2027.

results.title: NACOC defends Lebanon cocaine arrest, rejects claims of failed controlled delivery
results.content: The Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC) has rejected suggestions that its controlled delivery operation involving a 40-kilogramme cocaine shipment from Ghana to Lebanon was unsuccessful, insisting that the arrest of the suspect at Beirut International Airport was consistent with established procedures.

results.title: ICU-Ghana urges sustained breast cancer awareness beyond October
results.content: The Industrial and Commercial Workers' Union (ICU-Ghana) has urged Ghanaians to sustain breast cancer awareness efforts beyond October, emphasising the importance of early detection and timely medical intervention. The union says awareness campaigns should go beyond the annual Breast Cancer Awareness Month to encourage people to speak openly about the disease, seek medical advice and support those affected. results.title: Nii Noi earns Gospel Radio Show Host of the Year nomination at Praise Achievement Awards
results.content: The nomination recognises his work in gospel broadcasting, particularly his use of radio to promote gospel music, explore Christian teachings and engage listeners on matters of faith.

results.title: GIS trains 146 officers in weapon safety and armoury management
results.content: The Ghana Immigration Service (GIS) has trained 146 officers in weapon safety and armoury management as part of efforts to strengthen operational discipline, accountability and national security.

results.title: Traditional leaders, MMDCEs culpable in galamsey – President of National House of Chiefs
results.content: The President of the National House of Chiefs, Ogyeahoho Yaw Gyebi II, says some traditional leaders and MMDCEs are thwarting efforts to fight illegal mining through their active participation in the menace.

results.title: NFA launches Cinema Train to boost Ghanaian film industry
results.content: The National Film Authority (NFA) has launched the Cinema Train Initiative, a new platform aimed at expanding access to cinema, improving film exhibition and creating sustainable revenue opportunities for Ghanaian filmmakers.
